doc: COSTGUARD-1: external D1 budgets the tick Worker samples hourly (worker/src/costsample.js). Each budget has a probed failure mode in failure-modes.json. QNFO lives on the quniverse Cloudflare account; the read-only analytics token is bound to the Worker as CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN.

budgets.note: 30d baseline 29.0B rows read (about 40M/hr); debounce trigger from QNFO/qnfo-workers PR 11618 applied 2026-11-13.
